# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to revert to VWAP when the EMA ribbon is bullish, offering a high‑probability long entry on pullbacks. This setup combines VWAP mean-reversion with ribbon alignment—a combination absent from the registry—to capture intraday continuation after shallow retracements in bullish momentum environments.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When SPY price closes below VWAP by ≤0.1% and the 9‑EMA is above the 20‑EMA which is above the 50‑EMA (bullish ribbon) and RSI(14) < 45, enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Initial stop at 0.5% below entry or at the prior swing low (chart‑stop), target 1.5R, trail remaining position with a chandelier exit at 2.5×ATR(5). Regime hint: Best when VIX < 18 and time between 09:45‑11:30 EST; avoid during FOMC windows.
